name: CrossformerAttention

x.description: input token sequence (B, N, C) or flattened spatial tokens

feature_shape.description: optional spatial shape (H, W) to reshape x before grouping

reference:
import torch.nn as nn
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, group_size, q=None, k=None, v=None, num_heads=1, mask=None, scale=None, pos_bias=None, feature_shape=None):
    if num_heads is None:
        num_heads = 1
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    B, N, C = x.shape

    if isinstance(group_size, int):
        gh = gw = group_size
    else:
        gh, gw = group_size

    def _attention(x_loc, q_loc, k_loc, v_loc, num_heads, mask, scale, pos_bias):
        B_loc, N_loc, C_loc = x_loc.shape
        head_dim = C_loc // num_heads

        def to_heads(t):
            return t.view(B_loc, N_loc, num_heads, head_dim).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)

        qh = to_heads(q_loc)
        kh = to_heads(k_loc)
        vh = to_heads(v_loc)

        scale_val = scale if scale is not None else (head_dim ** -0.5)
        qh = qh * scale_val

        attn = torch.matmul(qh.float(), kh.transpose(-2, -1).float())
        if pos_bias is not None:
            if pos_bias.dim() == 2:
                attn = attn + pos_bias.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).float()
            else:
                attn = attn + pos_bias.unsqueeze(0).float()
        if mask is not None:
            if mask.dim() == 2:
                attn = attn + mask.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).float()
            else:
                attn = attn + mask.float()

        attn = F.softmax(attn, dim=-1)
        out_heads = torch.matmul(attn, vh.float()).to(dtype=x.dtype)
        out = out_heads.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous().view(B_loc, N_loc, C_loc)
        return out

    if feature_shape is not None:
        H, W = feature_shape
        x_2d = x.view(B, H, W, C)
        num_h = H // gh
        num_w = W // gw
        x_groups = x_2d.view(B, num_h, gh, num_w, gw, C)
        x_groups = x_groups.permute(0, 1, 3, 2, 4, 5).contiguous()
        x_groups = x_groups.view(B, num_h * num_w, gh * gw, C)
        B_flat = B * num_h * num_w
        x_flat = x_groups.view(B_flat, gh * gw, C)

        if q is not None:
            q_2d = q.view(B, H, W, C)
            q_groups = q_2d.view(B, num_h, gh, num_w, gw, C).permute(0, 1, 3, 2, 4, 5).contiguous()
            q_flat = q_groups.view(B_flat, gh * gw, C)
        else:
            q_flat = x_flat
        if k is not None:
            k_2d = k.view(B, H, W, C)
            k_groups = k_2d.view(B, num_h, gh, num_w, gw, C).permute(0, 1, 3, 2, 4, 5).contiguous()
            k_flat = k_groups.view(B_flat, gh * gw, C)
        else:
            k_flat = x_flat
        if v is not None:
            v_2d = v.view(B, H, W, C)
            v_groups = v_2d.view(B, num_h, gh, num_w, gw, C).permute(0, 1, 3, 2, 4, 5).contiguous()
            v_flat = v_groups.view(B_flat, gh * gw, C)
        else:
            v_flat = x_flat

        out_flat = _attention(x_flat, q_flat, k_flat, v_flat, num_heads, mask, scale, pos_bias)
        out_groups = out_flat.view(B, num_h * num_w, gh * gw, C)
        out_groups = out_groups.view(B, num_h, num_w, gh, gw, C)
        out_groups = out_groups.permute(0, 1, 3, 2, 4, 5).contiguous()
        out = out_groups.view(B, H, W, C)
        out = out.view(B, H * W, C)
        return out
    else:
        q_in = x if q is None else q
        k_in = x if k is None else k
        v_in = x if v is None else v
        out = _attention(x, q_in, k_in, v_in, num_heads, mask, scale, pos_bias)
        return out
description: CrossFormer group attention that applies multi-head self-attention within spatial or token groups.
